# Containers

The containers (applications and data stores) of each system in Big Bank plc.

## Internet Banking System

Lets customers view their accounts and make payments.

| Container | Technology | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API Application | Java and Spring MVC | Provides the banking functionality \| over JSON. | owner: Platform team |
| Database | Oracle | Stores user registration information. |  |
| Web Application | Java and Spring MVC | Delivers the static content. |  |
